source_packet.content_job: Find developing public X arguments worth rebuilding as owner-review LinkedIn concepts for specific B2B audiences.
public_brand_facts: Example Owner is a product operator who builds practical AI workflows.
Public position: useful AI work needs judgment, verification, and a repeatable system.

prior_shortlist: The agent marked it done. What did we verify?

claim_limits: Do not invent buyer demand, customer outcomes, product functionality, anecdotes, metrics, or emotions.
Do not treat X popularity as B2B demand or the X-to-LinkedIn lag as an algorithm fact.
Do not copy creator language or mechanically cross-post X content.
Hooks and positions are research hypotheses pending owner interview and copy acceptance.
